title: Downloads folder
whyItMatters: Downloads often holds installers, statements and files that were never filed away. It is a common place for private leftovers.
source: Apple macOS User Guide, Downloads folder in the home folder
notes: Downloads is TCC-protected; without Full Disk Access the scan records a permission skip. File contents are never opened.

cleanup.exportFirst: Copy anything you want to keep to an external drive or another computer before touching this folder.
steps: Open the folder named in the plan and decide file by file what has to go.
Move the files you keep to an external drive, then check that they open.
Move the rest to the Trash, then empty the Trash before the handover.
cleanup.risk: Everything left in Downloads is deleted for good once the Trash is emptied; installers can be downloaded again.
cleanup.source: Apple Support, Delete files and folders on Mac: https://support.apple.com/guide/mac-help/delete-files-and-folders-on-mac-mchlp1093/mac
